usedFor: Campaign Monitor holds your email list and Microsoft Excel keeps the record, so “New Subscriber” runs “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Subscriber” in Campaign Monitor, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Every signup becomes a new row in your Excel table, so the list is easy to sort and share.

watchOut: “New Subscriber” in Campaign Monitor is polling, so rows reach Excel after a scheduled check.
